[IARC.3.11.1] Sole reader of wall time per
RARC.5.5.
Mockable interface — in live mode `clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC)` and
`clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME)`, read together;
in replay / test mode, the harness or recording
drives it. No other module reads `time(NULL)` or
equivalent; this is an architectural invariant, and
reviews enforce it. The one exception is the pump-WCET
measurement of a real-time tier, which reads elapsed host
time directly. No rule reads that value; it decides only the
halt of [RTCT.7.3]. On a microcontroller build the clock
source reads the board's shim ([IARC.3.11.2]).
